item.title: Long road to becoming a lawyer: Delivery rider ranks 20th in the Bar, plans to join PAO
item.description: MANILA, Philippines – Bar passer Ronald Vincent Gonzales’ journey to the legal profession is a testament to resilience, discipline, and faith. Once a delivery rider navigating city streets, Gonzales is now a newly minted lawyer who placed 20th in the 2025 Bar Examinations, proving that detours do not diminish destiny.
